description: Ground truth compliance review checklist across 18 legal risk dimensions for synthetic contracts

governing_law.name: Governing Law & Jurisdiction
governing_law.description: State or governing jurisdiction and court venue specified for contract interpretation and legal actions.

liability_cap.name: Limitation of Liability & Caps
liability_cap.description: Aggregate monetary liability cap, multipliers (e.g. 6 or 12 months fees paid), and super-caps or exclusions.

ip_assignment.name: IP Ownership & Work-for-Hire Assignment
ip_assignment.description: Ownership of deliverables, work-for-hire provisions, pre-existing background IP, and licensing terms.

indemnification_scope.name: Indemnification Obligations & Limits
indemnification_scope.description: Indemnification coverage (IP infringement, breach of confidentiality), mutual vs unilateral, and whether capped.

termination_notice.name: Termination Notice Periods
termination_notice.description: Required advance notice periods for termination for convenience and cure periods for termination for cause.

confidentiality_term.name: Confidentiality Duration & Survival
confidentiality_term.description: Survival period of confidentiality obligations post-termination, including perpetual exceptions (trade secrets/PII).

audit_rights.name: Audit Rights & Compliance Inspection
audit_rights.description: Customer audit frequency, notice window, access scope (books, records, systems, or SOC 2 reports), and fee coverage.

non_solicitation.name: Non-Solicitation of Personnel
non_solicitation.description: Duration and scope of non-solicitation covenants restricting recruitment of employees or contractors.

payment_terms.name: Payment Timing & Late Fees
payment_terms.description: Net payment terms (e.g. Net 30, Net 45), invoice dispute mechanisms, and late payment interest rates.

dispute_resolution.name: Dispute Resolution & Arbitration
dispute_resolution.description: Mandatory dispute escalation tiers (negotiation, mediation) and binding arbitration rules/forum (AAA, JAMS).

force_majeure.name: Force Majeure & Suspension Rights
force_majeure.description: Events qualifying as force majeure, carve-outs (IT/cyber outages), and termination rights if delay persists.

assignment_change_of_control.name: Assignment & Change of Control
assignment_change_of_control.description: Restrictions on assigning agreement, affiliate exceptions, and termination rights upon change of control to competitor.

insurance_requirements.name: Insurance Coverage Requirements
insurance_requirements.description: Mandatory insurance policies (CGL, Cyber/E&O, Crime, Workers Comp) and minimum coverage limits.

warranty_period.name: Warranties & Warranty Period
warranty_period.description: Scope and duration of product or deliverable warranties (e.g. 90 or 180 days) and exclusive remedies.

data_privacy_security.name: Data Privacy & Security Breach Notification
data_privacy_security.description: Data protection compliance (GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2) and mandatory breach notification timeline (24, 48, or 72 hours).

export_compliance.name: Export Control & Sanctions Compliance
export_compliance.description: Adherence to U.S. EAR, ITAR, and OFAC sanctions restrictions.

subcontracting_rights.name: Subcontracting Permissions & Liability
subcontracting_rights.description: Rights to engage subcontractors, prior written approval requirements, and prime contractor liability.

severability_entire_agreement.name: Severability & Entire Agreement
severability_entire_agreement.description: Severability clause and merger/entire agreement clause superseding prior understandings and defining order of precedence.

governing_law.expected_value: State of Delaware substantive laws, without regard to conflict of law principles; courts in Wilmington, Delaware.

liability_cap.expected_value: Direct damages capped at $50,000 USD; excludes breach of Section 2 (Confidentiality) or Section 8 (Non-Solicitation). Consequential damages waived.

ip_assignment.expected_value: No IP assignment or work-for-hire created; all Confidential Information remains exclusive property of Disclosing Party.

indemnification_scope.expected_value: Mutual indemnification for unauthorized disclosure or intentional misappropriation of Confidential Information; expressly uncapped (exempt from $50,000 cap).

termination_notice.expected_value: Term of 2 years; either Party may terminate for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice.

confidentiality_term.expected_value: Survives for five (5) years from date of initial disclosure; perpetual survival for trade secrets.

audit_rights.expected_value: Disclosing Party may designate independent certified third-party auditor upon thirty (30) days' advance notice; once per 12-month period during normal business hours to verify data handling/destruction.

non_solicitation.expected_value: Mutual non-solicitation of technical and executive employees during term and for twelve (12) months following termination; general public job ads excluded.

payment_terms.expected_value: Not applicable / silent; Section 15.3 confirms this is an NDA with no commercial payment terms established.

dispute_resolution.expected_value: Good faith executive negotiations within 20 business days; followed by confidential binding arbitration administered by AAA Commercial Rules before a single arbitrator in Wilmington, Delaware.

force_majeure.expected_value: Excuses performance delay for acts of God, war, pandemic, etc.; explicitly excludes obligations of confidentiality and non-disclosure.

assignment_change_of_control.expected_value: No assignment without prior written consent, except permitted without consent to affiliates or in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets.

insurance_requirements.expected_value: Not applicable / silent; Section 15.3 explicitly notes insurance requirements are omitted from this NDA.

warranty_period.expected_value: Not applicable / silent; Section 15.3 confirms product warranties are absent from this NDA.

data_privacy_security.expected_value: Compliance with GDPR/CCPA; administrative/technical safeguards; breach notification required within forty-eight (48) hours in writing.

export_compliance.expected_value: Compliance with U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and OFAC sanctions; governmental authorization required prior to transfer.

subcontracting_rights.expected_value: Not applicable / silent; commercial subcontracting is not governed under this NDA.

severability_entire_agreement.expected_value: Standard severability; entire agreement superseding prior understandings; amendments must be in writing signed by authorized representatives.

governing_law.expected_value: Laws of the State of California; exclusive jurisdiction in state and federal courts located in San Francisco County, California.

liability_cap.expected_value: Total cumulative liability capped at total fees paid/payable in the six (6) months preceding the incident; excludes confidentiality (Section 4), customer indemnity (Section 8.2), and vendor IP indemnity (governed by separate $2M cap).

ip_assignment.expected_value: Vendor retains all IP in Subscription Service and models. Customer owns all Customer Data and bespoke analytical reports/outputs (Work Product).

indemnification_scope.expected_value: Vendor indemnifies Customer for third-party U.S. copyright/patent/trade secret claims up to $2,000,000 USD cap. Customer indemnifies Vendor for infringing Customer Data without cap.

termination_notice.expected_value: Customer may terminate for convenience with sixty (60) days advance written notice (no refund; Vendor cannot terminate for convenience during initial term). Termination for cause requires thirty (30) days cure notice.

key_parameters.convenience_notice: Customer: 60 days (Vendor: no convenience right in initial term)

confidentiality_term.expected_value: Confidentiality obligations survive for three (3) years post-termination; trade secrets and Customer Data protected perpetually.

audit_rights.expected_value: Customer may request most recent SOC 2 Type II audit report once per 12 months under NDA. On-site physical audits strictly prohibited except under regulatory mandate.

key_parameters.report_access: SOC 2 Type II once per 12 months

non_solicitation.expected_value: Mutual non-solicitation for twelve (12) months following termination; general recruitment ads excluded.

payment_terms.expected_value: Net 30 days from date of electronic invoice. Late fee: 1.5% per month or maximum permitted by law.

dispute_resolution.expected_value: 30-day executive VP escalation; followed by binding JAMS arbitration under Comprehensive Arbitration Rules in San Francisco, CA before a single neutral arbitrator.

force_majeure.expected_value: Performance excused for beyond control causes. If force majeure persists for > 45 consecutive calendar days, either Party may terminate immediately without penalty.

assignment_change_of_control.expected_value: Neither party may assign without written consent, except in connection with a merger or acquisition, provided assignee is not a direct commercial competitor.

insurance_requirements.expected_value: Vendor maintains $2M CGL aggregate ($1M per occurrence), $1M Worker's Comp, and $5,000,000 Cyber Risk & Tech Errors & Omissions (E&O). Customer named as additional insured on CGL.

warranty_period.expected_value: Ninety (90) days from initial service provisioning. Exclusive remedy is commercially reasonable repair within 30 days or pro-rata refund of prepaid unearned fees.

key_parameters.remedy: Correction within 30 days or pro-rata refund

data_privacy_security.expected_value: Maintains SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001; CCPA and GDPR compliance; security breach notification required within seventy-two (72) hours of confirming breach.

export_compliance.expected_value: Compliance with U.S. EAR and OFAC trade sanctions; representation that customer is not in embargoed jurisdiction.

subcontracting_rights.expected_value: Vendor permitted to utilize subcontractors (including cloud hosting like AWS/GCP); Vendor remains fully responsible and liable for subcontractor acts/omissions.

key_parameters.permission: Permitted without prior consent for Tier-1 hosting/infrastructure

severability_entire_agreement.expected_value: Severability clause; entire agreement clause merging all order forms, exhibits, and schedules; modifications require signed writing.

governing_law.expected_value: Substantive laws of the State of New York, without conflict of laws principles; exclusive venue in state and federal courts in New York County, New York.

liability_cap.target_section: Section 11.2, Section 11.3, Section 11.4, Schedule B Section 4
liability_cap.expected_value: General aggregate cap: 12 months fees paid. Enhanced Super-Cap: $5,000,000 USD or 3x fees (whichever is greater) for Schedule B security breaches, confidentiality (Section 6), or data loss. Indemnification (Section 12), gross negligence/fraud, and IP ownership breach are completely UNCAPPED.

ip_assignment.target_section: Section 4.1, Section 4.2, Section 4.3, Schedule A Section 2
ip_assignment.expected_value: Deliverables are works made for hire assigned to Customer upon payment. Provider retains Background IP and grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use Background IP integrated into deliverables.

key_parameters.ownership: Customer owns Deliverables (work made for hire)
key_parameters.license: Perpetual, irrevocable license to Provider Background IP

indemnification_scope.expected_value: Provider indemnifies Customer for third-party IP infringement, gross negligence/intentional misconduct, regulatory violations, and property damage/bodily injury. All indemnification liabilities are strictly uncapped (exempt from general cap and super-cap).

termination_notice.expected_value: Customer may terminate for convenience upon ninety (90) calendar days' written notice (Provider has no convenience right). Termination for cause: thirty (30) days cure; Customer may terminate immediately without cure for Schedule B security breach or insolvency.

confidentiality_term.expected_value: Confidentiality obligations survive for five (5) years post-termination; perpetual survival for trade secrets, source code, financial records, and PII/NPI.

audit_rights.target_section: Section 8.1, Section 8.2, Section 8.3, Schedule B Section 5
audit_rights.expected_value: Customer or Big-4 CPA firm may audit books, systems, and controls once per calendar year upon fifteen (15) business days' notice. Immediate audits permitted for security incidents or regulatory inquiries. Provider reimburses audit costs if overcharges > 3% or material security deficiency.

key_parameters.frequency: Once per year, or immediate upon security incident/regulator inquiry
key_parameters.cost_shifting: Provider pays if overcharge > 3% or security deficiency

non_solicitation.expected_value: Mutual non-solicitation for eighteen (18) months following termination; liquidated damages equal to 50% of hired individual's annualized base salary.

payment_terms.expected_value: Net forty-five (45) calendar days from receipt of detailed invoice. Late fee: 1.0% per month. Customer may withhold disputed amounts upon notice within 20 days.

dispute_resolution.expected_value: Three-tiered resolution: (1) 15 days executive negotiation, (2) 30 days CPR mediation in New York, (3) Binding AAA arbitration under Commercial Rules before a 3-arbitrator panel seated in New York, NY.

key_parameters.tier_3: AAA Commercial arbitration, 3 arbitrators, seated in New York, NY

force_majeure.expected_value: Beyond reasonable control causes excused; IT failures, bugs, carrier outages, or foreseeable cyber attacks are explicitly excluded unless caused by catastrophic warfare. Customer may terminate if delay exceeds thirty (30) consecutive calendar days.

key_parameters.exclusion: Routine IT failures, software bugs, and carrier outages not force majeure

assignment_change_of_control.expected_value: No assignment without prior written consent, except Customer may assign to affiliates. If Provider undergoes Change of Control to a direct competitor in financial services/tech, Customer may terminate immediately with 30 days' notice.

key_parameters.competitor_change_of_control: Customer right to terminate on 30 days notice

insurance_requirements.expected_value: Provider must maintain: $5,000,000 CGL; $10,000,000 Cyber Risk & Tech E&O; $2,000,000 Commercial Crime & Fidelity Bond; $1,000,000 Workers Comp. Customer named as additional insured; 3-year tail requirement.

warranty_period.expected_value: One hundred and eighty (180) calendar days from written acceptance of each Deliverable. Exclusive remedies: repair/replacement within 15 calendar days or full refund of fees paid for defective Deliverable.

data_privacy_security.expected_value: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, GLBA, PCI-DSS; TLS 1.3 in transit and AES-256 at rest. Incident notification required in writing within twenty-four (24) hours of confirming or suspecting breach.

key_parameters.encryption: TLS 1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest

export_compliance.expected_value: Compliance with U.S. EAR, ITAR, and OFAC sanctions regulations.

subcontracting_rights.expected_value: Provider shall NOT subcontract without Customer's prior express written authorization. Subcontractors must be bound to terms at least as restrictive as Agreement (including Schedule B), and Provider remains primarily liable.

key_parameters.liability: Provider remains directly and primarily liable

severability_entire_agreement.expected_value: Severability; entire agreement merging all SOWs and schedules. Detailed Order of Precedence: Schedule B > Main Body > Schedule C > Schedule A > individual SOWs.

key_parameters.order_of_precedence: Schedule B > Main Body > Schedule C > Schedule A > SOW
